trigger.reason: Prior next_gate explicitly required auto-revisit on H1/H2/annual or primary IR disclosure with utilization/project-benefit metrics.

d2_answers.question: Separate organic growth from acquisition/consolidation effects.
d2_answers.fact: 2026 H1 reported revenue was RMB328.46m (+15.30% YoY), attributable net profit RMB130.98m (+35.32%), and recurring attributable net profit RMB124.45m (+41.04%). Post-H1 management communications attribute the stronger growth mainly to smart-connected and commercial-vehicle testing demand while traditional testing remained stable; the refreshed public record still does not provide a full pro-forma entity bridge that isolates same-store organic growth from the previously consolidated extreme-climate asset.
d2_answers.interpretation: The operating direction improved, but the exact organic/consolidation split remains only partially observable.

d2_answers.question: Model utilization, pricing, incremental margins and ROIC for new testing capacity.
d2_answers.fact: The H1 disclosure and 2026-08-24 results meeting confirm Salt City remains in capacity ramp, utilization varies with season and OEM R&D cadence, and the new all-season ice/snow base is still under construction with full operation targeted for 2028. They do not disclose Salt City realized utilization %, realized price/mix, project-level incremental margin, or project-level invested-capital return. The ice/snow base therefore has no mature operating return series yet.
d2_answers.interpretation: The trigger produced new directional evidence but not the decisive underwriting variables. Faster H1 profit growth is insufficient to attribute returns to the new capacity without project-level utilization and margin data.

d2_answers.question: Assess convertible-bond dilution and balance-sheet implications.
d2_answers.fact: The RMB1.03904bn convertible bond remains outstanding with RMB5.99 initial conversion price. H1 period-end total assets rose to roughly RMB4.93bn, partly reflecting financing proceeds; the company continues to fund the ice/snow base and other test-road/equipment upgrades. The H1 board also approved a roughly RMB273.63m refrigeration-equipment procurement for the ice/snow project.
d2_answers.interpretation: Liquidity and project funding capacity are stronger, but balance-sheet expansion is financing-led and prospective dilution remains economically relevant until incremental earnings from the new assets are demonstrated.

d2_answers.question: Map competitive moat and customer concentration.
d2_answers.fact: Post-H1 management communication reiterates the nationwide multi-base/full-scenario testing network, rare testing qualifications and technical/team capability as the core moat. It also states customer concentration improved in H1, but no new sufficiently granular top-customer schedule in the materials reviewed here supersedes the prior concentration gate.
d2_answers.interpretation: Network breadth and scenario coverage remain credible structural advantages; customer concentration risk appears directionally better but is not cleared quantitatively.

d2_answers.question: Define valuation ceiling and utilization/ROIC kill conditions.
d2_answers.assumption: Do not raise the prior valuation ceiling merely because H1 earnings accelerated or because the bond financing closed. Continue to require a mature after-tax project return above the 8-10% research hurdle before treating new capacity as value-accretive.
d2_answers.judgment: HOLD. Kill conditions remain: prolonged Salt City under-utilization, realized price/mix failing to support incremental margin, mature after-tax project ROIC below the 8-10% research hurdle, customer concentration worsening while third-party demand weakens, or convertible-bond dilution without proportionate earnings accretion. H1 does not provide enough project-level evidence to clear these conditions.

core_investment_judgment_change: NO_PROMOTION. H1 improves evidence that demand and profit are growing, but does not resolve the core capacity-economics gap; retain HOLD_NOT_DECISION_GRADE.

evidence_gap.missing: Salt City/project-level realized utilization, realized pricing/mix, incremental margin and mature invested-capital return series; equivalent realized economics for the new ice/snow base once operational.
